list.title: Automations

list.duplicatedDescription: The copy is saved as a draft.

empty.title: No automations yet
empty.description: An automation watches for a keyword in a comment or a message and sends a direct message with your link, so nobody waits for an answer.
empty.noChannelDescription: Automations reply from a connected account. Connect one in Channels, then come back to create your first automation.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: It stops replying right away, and its tracked links stop counting clicks. Past deliveries stay in the activity log. This cannot be undone.

builder.newDescription: Choose what starts it, what it listens for and what it sends.
builder.editDescription: Changes apply to the next comment or message that arrives.
builder.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted by someone else in the workspace.
builder.summaryDescription: Nothing has been saved yet. Each link goes to its field.
builder.createdDescription: It replies to the next match.
builder.createdDraftDescription: It stays off until you activate it.

errors.channelRequired: Choose the account it replies from.

noChannel.title: Connect an Instagram account first
noChannel.description: An automation replies from a connected account, and there is none in this workspace yet.

basics.title: Basics
basics.name: Name
basics.nameHint: Only your team sees it, in lists and in the activity log.
basics.namePlaceholder: Price list for the spring launch

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.commentHint: Someone comments on a post or reel.
trigger.messageHint: Someone sends a direct message, or replies to a story.
trigger.scopeAnyDescription: Every post, including the ones you publish later.
trigger.scopeSpecificDescription: Only the posts you pick below.
trigger.scopeNextDescription: It attaches to the first post that appears after you activate it.
trigger.scopeBufferDescription: It attaches to the post once Buffer publishes it.
trigger.bufferNotConnected: Connect Buffer to attach an automation to a scheduled post.
trigger.bufferNoPosts: There are no scheduled posts in Buffer right now.
trigger.postsHint: Up to {max}. Showing the latest posts of this account.
trigger.postsSelected: {count, plural, =0 {No posts selected} one {# post selected} other {# posts selected}}
trigger.postsEmpty: This account has no posts yet.
trigger.postsChooseChannel: Choose an account to see its posts.

match.title: Match
match.keywordsDescription: Only when the text includes one of your keywords.
match.anythingDescription: Every comment or message gets the reply.
match.keywordHint: Press Enter to add. Up to {max}. Case, accents and emoji are ignored.
match.keywordsFull: You have reached the limit of {max} keywords.
match.testHint: Type a comment to see whether this automation would reply.
match.testPlaceholder: How much does it cost? Send me the price!
match.oncePerContactDescription: Someone who comments again does not get the message twice.

response.title: Response
response.publicReplyDescription: Also answers the comment in public. One of your replies is picked at random, so they do not all look the same.
response.openingDescription: Instagram only lets you send links once the person has answered. This message asks them to tap its button, and the content goes out when they do.
response.openingPlaceholder: Hi {username}! Tap below and I’ll send you the link.
response.followGateDescription: People who do not follow the account get this message first, and the content once they follow and tap the button. If Instagram does not say whether they follow, the content is sent anyway.
response.followPlaceholder: Follow the account and tap below to get it.
response.messageHint: Write {username} to greet the person by their handle.
response.buttonsHint: Up to {max}. Clicks are counted for each button.
response.buttonsEmpty: No buttons. Links in the message still work, without click counts.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: What the person sees in Instagram.
